zh.text: 模组市场重排：左侧筛选栏 + 顶部精选区 + 四列卡片网格，精选区固定为设计高度并限制简介字数；补充「已安装 / 可更新 / 未安装 / 我收藏的」快捷筛选；市场统计改用星星数，排序改成一行标签式按钮。
主内容区加入轻量页面切入动画、稳定滚动条与滚动边界，页签切换不再那么生硬。
模组分类新增舰船、装备、皮肤、界面、动画、声音六类，旧的「画面」自动归入「界面」；创建模组表单同步可选这些新分类。
模组市场精选区换成深空采矿横幅，并加入缓慢漂移与掠光动效；底部操作按钮重新与卡片底边对齐，不再贴边裁切。
模组详情弹窗改为短时淡入，去掉遮罩模糊与缩放跳变，不再出现「先出阴影再弹详情」的观感。
模组市场排序新增「当前版本」：按市场版本号从高到低排，同版本再按下载量排。
模组市场新增本机收藏：左侧筛选里的「我创建的」换成「我收藏的」，详情页增加收藏图标，精选区的收藏按钮与获星彻底分开。

en.text: The mod market was re-laid out: a left filter rail, a featured hero on top and a four-column card grid. The hero keeps a fixed design height and caps the description length, quick filters cover installed / updatable / not installed / my favorites, market stats now count stars, and sorting became a row of tag buttons.
The main content area gained a light page-enter animation, stable scrollbars and scroll boundaries, so switching tabs no longer feels abrupt.
Six new mod categories: ships, fittings, skins, UI, animation and sound. The old Visual category folds into UI automatically, and the create-mod form offers the new categories as well.
The market hero now uses a deep-space mining banner with a slow drift and a light sweep, and the action buttons at the bottom line up with the card edge again instead of being clipped.
The mod detail dialog now fades in briefly: the backdrop blur and the zoom jump are gone, so it no longer shows a shadow first and then pops into place.
The market sort menu gained Current version, which orders by market version descending and breaks ties by download count.
The mod market now has local favorites: the left filter's My mods entry became My favorites, the detail dialog gained a favorite icon, and the hero's favorite button is fully separated from starring.
